about: Built-in command tools. `args` is an argv template run with execFile (never a shell): "{x}" is replaced by argument x, "{x...}" by x split on spaces (enums only), and a nested array is a group kept only when every placeholder in it has a value (a boolean placeholder keeps its group when true and is itself dropped). A tool is offered only when `bin` is on PATH. Every run goes through the Reflex gate first.

tools.name: rg_search
tools.description: Search file contents in the working tree for a text or regular expression with ripgrep; prints matching lines with file and line number.

pattern.description: The text or regular expression to look for inside files

path.description: The directory or file to search in

glob.description: A file-name filter such as *.go or *.tf, limiting which files are searched

ignore_case.description: Match regardless of upper or lower case

tools.name: grep_search
tools.description: Search file contents under a directory for a text or regular expression with grep; prints matching lines with file and line number, skipping binary files.

pattern.description: The text or regular expression to look for inside files

path.description: The directory or file to search in

glob.description: A file-name filter such as *.py, limiting which files are searched

ignore_case.description: Match regardless of upper or lower case

tools.name: ast_grep
tools.description: Structural code search with ast-grep: find code matching a syntax pattern such as console.log($A), not just text.

pattern.description: The code pattern to match, written as code with $VARS as wildcards

lang.description: The programming language of the code being searched

path.description: The directory or file to search in

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show the commit history of the repository, or of one file or directory: hash and subject per commit, newest first.

path.description: Only commits touching this file or directory

max_count.description: How many commits to show at most

author.description: Only commits by this person (name or email)

since.description: Only commits after this date or age, such as 2024-01-01 or 2.weeks

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show uncommitted changes in the working tree, or the changes between the working tree and a branch, tag or commit.

ref.description: The branch, tag or commit to compare against, such as main or HEAD~1

path.description: Only changes to this file or directory

stat.description: Only a summary of changed files and line counts, not the full diff

tools.name: git_blame
tools.description: Show who last changed each line of a file, and in which commit.

lines.description: Only this line range, written start,end such as 10,40

tools.name: kubectl_get
tools.description: List Kubernetes resources (pods, deployments, services, nodes, ...) in a cluster, read-only.

resource.description: The kind of Kubernetes resource to list (not secrets), such as pods, deployments, services or nodes

context.description: The kubeconfig context, which selects the cluster

tools.name: kubectl_describe
tools.description: Show the detailed state and recent events of one Kubernetes resource, read-only; useful to see why a pod is failing.

resource.description: The kind of Kubernetes resource, such as pod, deployment or node

context.description: The kubeconfig context, which selects the cluster

tools.name: aws_describe
tools.description: Read-only AWS inventory: list or describe EC2 instances, VPCs, security groups, S3 buckets, RDS databases, EKS and ECS clusters, Lambda functions, IAM roles, CloudFormation stacks, or show the current identity.

operation.description: What to look up in AWS

region.description: The AWS region, such as eu-west-1

profile.description: The named AWS CLI profile, which selects the account
